name: True Hero
description: (Tag:light+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the True Hero blessed by the divines. Your Light and Holy-based abilities and physical abilities are greatly enhanced, and all blessings on you are stronger and longer-lasting. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings regard you with reverence and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.
